title: Darry H NDE 9933
content: I was at a party and left. A guy who was mad at me about a female followed me outside. As I went to walk up the stairs, he shot me point blank in the back of my head. I could hear people screaming. I was floating up and over the houses. I could feel the direction I was going in. When people were talking to me, it sounded like they were going farther away. When I responded, I could feel myself in my body and on the ground. As soon as I stopped talking, I was floating away again. This happened 3 or 4 times. All of a sudden, I could feel the ambulance turning corners. The paramedics said, 'Are you with us Bud?' I asked, 'Are you going to help me?' He replied, 'We’re going to help you, Bud.' I couldn’t see. I got to shock-trauma at 10 pm. I couldn’t figure out what was happening and said to myself, 'I think I'm dead. Later, a witness told me he heard me say that, 'You can’t kill me, only God can kill me.' Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 08/29/2000 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Surgery-related. Criminal attack. While under general anesthesia. Direct head injury. Life threatening event, but not clinical death. I was shot point bank in the head. The bullet crushed the back of my skull and penetrated 3cm into my brain. How do you consider the content of your experience? Neither pleasant NOR distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal. I kept feeling confused and couldn’t figure out what was happening At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Whole time Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. There was no sense of time Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I couldn’t see Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Heightened still to this day Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes It was a pitch black plane, but I could see Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Growing light coming for me. I ran from it Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. It was a strange pitch-black realm but I could also see with no light What emotions did you feel during the experience? Confusion Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe. Nothing seemed to even matter Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will. The light wasn’t there at first but I walked towards it until it made me feel uneasy God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Other Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Secular unaffiliated Other: believe in God bit not religious Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. Everyone always says tunnel but it was a vast, pitch-black plane Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes. I'm not arrogant anymore Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes Someone has to be behind that light Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes I was physically in another realm with no body and I was alive in every way to me. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? It’s hard to trust women After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. It’s burned in my memory Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes My intuition doesn’t fail since Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. It was real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes Seeing someone else get shot Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Ok os38084_nde

tunnel.passage_other_detail: It was a pitch black plane, but I could see.

environment.environment_other_detail: A strange pitch-black realm/plane where he could see with no light.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He repeatedly shifted between floating away and feeling himself in his body when speaking; later felt ambulance turning corners.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Shot point blank in the back of the head at a party; later reported as surgery-related/under general anesthesia and direct head injury.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Prior: Other. Now: secular unaffiliated; believes in God but not religious.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated alternation between being out of body and feeling in body when talking.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with repeated partial returns while speaking; later awareness of ambulance movement; described a pitch-black plane/tunnel and a barrier with an approaching light.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Shifted between floating away and being in his body 3 or 4 times when responding to people.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He described the 'tunnel' as a vast pitch-black plane where he could still see; he ran from a growing unearthly light; he repeatedly snapped back into his body when speaking and floated away again when he stopped.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was floating up and over the houses.” “As soon as I stopped talking, I was floating away again.” “I think I'm dead.” “You can’t kill me, only God can kill me.” “It was a strange pitch-black realm but I could also see with no light.” “Someone has to be behind that light.”
